Strong Japanese heavy gothic headline typography with subtle ink texture. Clearly an illustration, not a photograph, not a photorealistic render. Minimal elements, punchy and readable at small size. Do NOT copy the old reference's player, numbers, scores, name or date.

Editorial content: a pregame preview of Ryukyu versus Tokyo SR on 2026-11-12. The headline asks whether Ryukyu can end its losing streak. No outcome is known in the supplied manuscript; participation of the players on that day is unconfirmed.

Composition: Typography occupies the left 47%, an energetic basketball one-on-one illustration occupies the right 53%, with comfortable separation and all essential text, faces, fingers and the ball inside a 5% safe margin. Show TWO real athletes, not generic fictional players: Jack Cooley of Ryukyu defending in a lowered wide stance, and Leo Vendrame of Tokyo driving with a single orange basketball controlled under his near hand at hip height. Bodies angle into each other across a diagonal, faces visible in three-quarter views rather than hidden in profile. Clearly different heights and builds: Cooley is the much taller, broader center; Vendrame is the shorter athletic guard. Mid-thigh to head framing, anatomically plausible arms and fingers, natural movement. Cooley slightly behind and higher, Vendrame lower in foreground. This is a conceptual matchup image, never an alleged recreation of the actual game. No scoreboard, winner, score, dunk result, arena photo, crowd or hoop needed.
